items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: ONE modern Pipamon assembly workbench for Professor Assis's Brazilian kite workshop, isolated on real transparent alpha. Reference 1 is only the exact orthographic 2:1 isometric footprint/view of the old table; reference 2 supplies the NEW hand drawn 2D manga/cartoon style and palette. Make a wide clean contemporary assembly bench, 4 by 2 floor cells, viewed from above with long front edge descending towards screen-right, matching guide. Off-white quartz-like thin tabletop, navy blue modular drawers and open knee space, slim light-oak edging, brushed silver feet. On top: one partly built PAPER KITE on a pale technical cutting mat, two small thread/rabiola spools, a compact angled blue tablet and one articulated white task lamp. A small restrained cyan-lit inspection ring arches above the REAR center of the tabletop; magical research craftsmanship, NOT sci-fi machinery. All equipment attached securely to tabletop, no large protruding props, no base platform. Crisp dark navy ink outlines, broad clean cel-shaded shapes, restrained highlights, style consistent with reference 2. Single coherent object, no walls/floor/background, no person, no text, no labels, no glow behind the object, no cast floor shadow, no multiple views. Fill canvas with safe clear margin. No photorealism or 3D render appearance. Real transparent background.
